method: Actual exported airframe triangles posed by production rig; actual exported engine triangles posed by matching source three-bearing solver. BVH + bidirectional segment/triangle penetration. Tangential contact, coplanar overlap and shared seams ignored at 1e-6 m. All material visibility ignored. Sliding mating-ring contacts within 1 mm of bearing2 plane are separately counted (96-segment chord sag at radius .53 m is 0.284 mm); gross self-intersections must be zero. Forward airframe outside engine aft envelope is not checked here.
unqualified: Full containment in non-watertight airframe volumes
